subject: Hospitality
title: The Next Generation of Hoteliers
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Next Generation of Hoteliers.

hook.text: The next generation of hoteliers won't just build rooms—they'll build communities, platforms, and experiences.

buildup.text: Young hotel entrepreneurs blend tech fluency with old-school service values. They code apps and fold napkins equally well.

discovery.text: The Next Generation of Hoteliers reveals the mechanism or argument that changes the picture.

twist.text: The best new hoteliers study psychology, data science, and design—not just hotel management. The skillset is expanding rapidly.

climax.text: Hospitality's future leaders will need to master AI, sustainability, community building, and emotional intelligence.

punchline.text: Code, design, empathize, sustain. The next hotelier is a polymath.

quiz.question: How are next-generation hospitality concepts like Selina different?
options: They're traditional hotels with new names
They blur categories—combining hotels with co-living, co-working, and community
